how_to_steps: Install OmniRoute and point Claude Code at it as the provider
Install the claude-mem plugin for persistent memory
Add headroom as a proxy/plugin to compress context before API calls
Run claude-code-setup against a repo to get recommended skills/hooks/MCPs
Install task-observer so it logs corrections and suggests skill updates
